summary: Returns the squared magnitude (dot product with itself) of a three-component vector stored in mixed precision: float component at this+0x0, double component at this+0x4, and float component at this+0xC. Computed as the sum of each component multiplied by itself, promoted to double for the double term. Called by RecursiveTriangleEdgeSubdivisionForCollision (0044aae0), consistent with its use in collision-mesh edge length calculation.

local_names.this: vector-like object whose squared magnitude is computed

operations.description: Reads the float component at this+0x0 and squares it
Reads the double component at this+0x4 and squares it
Reads the float component at this+0xC and squares it
Returns the sum as a double (the squared magnitude)
Invoked by RecursiveTriangleEdgeSubdivisionForCollision (0044aae0) to size collision-mesh edges

unresolved: Field this+0x4 is read as a double while this+0x0 and this+0xC are floats; the struct layout producing this mixed precision is not defined here
